tools.name: brand-protection_product-image-similarity-check
tools.description: Decode the supplied reference and listing images and compare their pixels. Images that cannot be decoded are not compared, and a visual match is not proof of counterfeiting. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/brand-protection/product-image-similarity-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "brand-protection" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: brand-protection_product-image-similarity-check, brand-protection_unauthorized-seller-evidence-extract, brand-protection_intellectual-property-evidence-package, brand-protection_investigation-report · Private data: brand-protection_name-usage-audit, brand-protection_investigation-report · Public sink: brand-protection_product-listing-match, brand-protection_suspected-counterfeit-listing-detect, brand-protection_product-image-similarity-check, brand-protection_unauthorized-seller-evidence-extract, brand-protection_name-usage-audit, brand-protection_marketplace-listing-compare, brand-protection_intellectual-property-evidence-package, brand-protection_investigation-report · Destructive: brand-protection_product-listing-match, brand-protection_suspected-counterfeit-listing-detect, brand-protection_product-image-similarity-check, brand-protection_unauthorized-seller-evidence-extract, brand-protection_name-usage-audit, brand-protection_marketplace-listing-compare, brand-protection_intellectual-property-evidence-package, brand-protection_investigation-report.
